map.ROI = (活动带来收益 - 活动总成本) / 活动总成本 × 100%: ROI = (return brought by the event - total event cost) / total event cost x 100%
map.ROI 和 ROAS 有什么区别？: What is the difference between ROI and ROAS?
map.ROI 通常指（收入-成本）/成本，含全部投入；ROAS（广告支出回报）是收入/: ROI usually means (revenue - cost) / cost and covers all investment; ROAS (return on ad spend) is revenue / ad spend and looks only at the media-buying side. For event evaluation, look at both: ROAS measures acquisition efficiency, ROI measures overall profit and loss.
map.→ 打开活动（策划/执行/评估）方案工具: -> Open the event (planning / execution / evaluation) plan tool
map.参与率估不准怎么办？: What if the participation rate cannot be estimated accurately?
map.填入预期触达人数与到场/参与率，估算实际到场规模，倒推需要的宣传与接待资源。: Enter the expected number of people reached and the attendance or participation rate to estimate the actual turnout and work backwards to the publicity and reception resources needed.
map.按活动目标与预算，辅助生成策划、执行排期与效果评估框架，输出关键节点与 KPI，: Given the event goal and budget, it helps generate the planning, the execution schedule and the effect evaluation framework, and outputs key milestones and KPIs. Suitable for marketing event management, plan review and post-event review.
map.活动立项时把总预算拆成场地物料、推广投放、人员及其他，实时看各项占比，控制超支。: At event approval, split the total budget into venue and materials, promotion and placement, people and other, and watch each share live to keep overruns under control.
map.用历史同类型活动或行业基准先填，再按宣传力度上下浮动 sensitivity 分: Fill in historical figures for the same event type or an industry benchmark first, then run a sensitivity analysis by moving the figure up or down with promotional effort. Participation rate affects ROI strongly, so calculate optimistic, neutral and pessimistic scenarios separately rather than a single value.
map.给定人均消费或转化价值，算活动 ROI，判断值不值得办、预算怎么调。: Given spend per person or value per conversion, compute the event ROI to judge whether it is worth running and how to adjust the budget.
map.：总预算 50000 元（场地物料 15000、推广 20000、人员 8000: : total budget 50,000 CNY (venue and materials 15,000, promotion 20,000, people 8,000, other 7,000); expected reach 10,000 people with a 30% participation rate gives about 3,000 attendees; at 50 CNY spend per person revenue is about 150,000 CNY. ROI = (150,000 - 50,000) / 50,000 = 200%.
